quiz.q: A batch costs 35,750 naira in total and fills 25 good bottles. What is the cost per bottle?
quiz.explain: 35,750 / 25 = 1,430 naira per bottle.

quiz.q: Using price = cost / (1 minus margin), what is the price for a cost of 1,400 naira and a 30% margin?
Sulphonic acid has gone up in price. Which response is NOT honest?
options: Raise the price and explain why
Change the pack size and tell customers
Accept a smaller margin for a short time
Add extra water but keep the same label and price
quiz.explain: Secretly diluting the product while keeping the same label misleads customers.

quiz.q: Which is the strongest way to convince a restaurant manager to switch to your liquid soap?
options: Tell her it kills all germs
A side-by-side grease demo on her own pots
Offer the lowest price in town without testing
quiz.explain: A fair demonstration shows real performance and builds trust, without false claims.

quiz.q: A customer sends a transfer screenshot and asks you to deliver now. What should you do first?
options: Confirm the money has arrived in your account
quiz.explain: Fake transfer screenshots are a common scam. Check your account before releasing goods.

quiz.q: Bisi spent 36,000 naira on equipment and makes 600 naira profit per bottle. How many bottles must she sell to recover the start-up cost?
quiz.explain: 36,000 / 600 = 60 bottles to break even.

finalQuiz.q: What does the oil-loving tail of a surfactant molecule do during washing?
options: Pushes into grease so it can be wrapped and rinsed away
finalQuiz.explain: The tail grabs grease while the water-loving head lets water carry it away.

finalQuiz.q: Which order is correct for preparing caustic soda solution?
options: Pour water onto caustic soda quickly
Add caustic soda slowly to cold water, in a ventilated place, wearing PPE
Dissolve caustic soda in an aluminium pot
Mix caustic soda directly with sulphonic acid
finalQuiz.explain: Caustic soda goes into water slowly. Aluminium reacts with caustic and gives off hydrogen.

finalQuiz.q: A customer mixes bleach with vinegar and starts coughing. What gas has she most likely released, and what should she do?
options: Chlorine; move to fresh air and get medical help if symptoms continue
finalQuiz.explain: Bleach with acids such as vinegar releases chlorine gas. Fresh air first, medical help if symptoms persist.

finalQuiz.q: Why do formulators neutralise sulphonic acid in portions while checking pH, instead of adding a fixed amount of caustic?
options: pH strips are cheaper than caustic
Fixed amounts always give a thick product
Acid strength and caustic purity vary between suppliers
finalQuiz.explain: Raw material strength varies, so measuring pH is the only reliable way to reach near neutral.

finalQuiz.q: What is the main problem with using formalin as a preservative?
options: Formaldehyde is classified by IARC as a human carcinogen and its vapour irritates
finalQuiz.explain: Formalin is a formaldehyde solution. Use a supplier's detergent preservative at its stated dose instead.

finalQuiz.q: A 20-litre formula uses 400 g of an ingredient. How much is needed for a 2-litre test batch?
Ngozi keeps adding salt to her SLES hand wash and it begins to get thinner. What has happened?
options: She passed the peak of the salt curve
finalQuiz.explain: Salt thickens SLES products up to a peak, after which more salt thins them.

finalQuiz.q: According to CDC guidance, how should household bleach of 5% to 9% strength be prepared for disinfecting surfaces?
options: About 20 ml per litre of water, fresh daily, at least 1 minute contact
Mixed with liquid soap for extra strength
finalQuiz.explain: CDC: 5 tablespoons per gallon or 4 teaspoons per quart (about 20 ml per litre), fresh daily, at least 1 minute contact, never mixed.

finalQuiz.q: Which label line should be removed from a multipurpose liquid soap?
finalQuiz.explain: Germ-kill claims make it a disinfectant, which needs proof and approval.

finalQuiz.q: Under NAFDAC's MSME page, which statement is correct for micro scale?
options: Any number of products can be registered
Laundry detergents are listed, up to five products, and facilities have no more than nine employees
Detergents do not need NAFDAC at all
The listing certificate lasts ten years
finalQuiz.explain: The MSME page lists laundry detergents, limits micro scale to five products and nine employees, and gives a two-year listing validity.

finalQuiz.q: A school says your last keg stung cleaners' hands. What is the best first step?
options: Offer a discount on the next keg
Check the batch number, your record and the retained sample
finalQuiz.explain: Traceability through batch records and retained samples shows the real cause, often an incorrect pH.

finalQuiz.q: A batch costs 30,000 naira and fills 24 good bottles. With a 30% margin, about what should each bottle sell for before checking local prices?
finalQuiz.explain: Cost per bottle: 30,000 / 24 = 1,250 naira. Price: 1,250 / 0.70 = about 1,786 naira, then compare with the market.

capstone.title: Liquid soap production portfolio and 90-day plan
capstone.brief: Make one full production batch of multipurpose liquid soap (or hand wash) from a master formula you proved with test batches, test it against your own specification, label and cost it, sell or give it to real users, and submit an evidence portfolio with a reflection and a 90-day plan.
steps: Set up your safety station and complete your safety card, including the bleach rule and first aid.

Get feedback from at least two users, write a reflection, and write a 90-day plan.
